title: DUBAI GOLD SOUK & OLD DEIRA | Exploring the World's Largest Gold Market
description:
http://www.TravelsWithSheila.com
Take a small "Abra" for 1 Dirham across the creek to visit souks on both sides of Deira. A fun area and let me know if you've ever managed to buy any gold here -  the largest gold bazaar in the world. Please don't forget to Subscribe Share and Like. Thanks.
